details: Consequence of the registered max-over-subfamilies construction.
proof: For every subfamily $\mathcal G\subseteq\mathcal H$, $\mathrm Y(\mathcal G)\le |\mathcal G|\le |\mathcal H|$.  Taking the maximum over $\mathcal G$ gives $\mathrm Y^*(\mathcal H)\le |\mathcal H|$.
